meanings.usage: 指去陌生地方进行探索的人
修饰动词，表示某事顺利完成

meanings.meaning: 照片（指用相机拍摄的图片） verb. 拍照

meanings.usage: 使某人感到担忧或不便

meanings.meaning: 问题（指遭遇的困难或麻烦事） verb. 麻烦

meanings.usage: 指高度增加，用于飞机升起、价格上涨等

meanings.meaning: 订购（指上级对下级的命令或要求某物） noun. 命令

meanings.usage: 指看得清楚或理解清楚

meanings.meaning: 清除（指安全通过或越过某物） adjective. 清晰的

meanings.usage: in sight表示在视野中；out of sight表示看不见
表示看起来像某种情况

meanings.meaning: be able to...可能性,成功地做

phrases.usage: 遇到麻烦/困难，指突然遭遇问题

examples.en: They soon ran into serious trouble.
examples.zh: 他们很快遇到了严重的麻烦。

examples.en: The project ran into financial trouble.
examples.zh: 这个项目陷入了财务困境。

phrases.usage: 在某一时刻；在某种程度上

examples.en: At one point, it seemed certain that their plane would crash.
examples.zh: 在某个时刻，看起来他们的飞机肯定会坠毁。

examples.en: At one point, I thought I would give up.
examples.zh: 在某个时刻，我以为我会放弃。

examples.en: It could only get over the mountains if it rose to 10,000 feet.
examples.zh: 只有上升到一万英尺才能越过这些山脉。

examples.en: She couldn't get over her fear of heights.
examples.zh: 她无法克服恐高症。

phrases.usage: 上升到；上升到某个高度或水平

examples.en: The plane rose to 10,000 feet.
examples.zh: 飞机上升到一万英尺。

examples.en: The temperature will rise to 30 degrees today.
examples.zh: 今天气温将上升到30度。

examples.en: Byrd ordered his men to throw out two heavy food sacks.
examples.zh: 伯德命令他的手下扔出两个沉重的食物袋。

examples.en: Please throw out the trash.
examples.zh: 请把垃圾扔出去。

examples.en: It cleared the mountains by 400 feet.
examples.zh: 它以400英尺的高度越过了山脉。

examples.en: The horse cleared the fence by a foot.
examples.zh: 那匹马以一英尺的高度跃过了栅栏。

examples.en: There were no more mountains in sight.
examples.zh: 眼前再也没有山脉了。

examples.en: The destination was finally in sight.
examples.zh: 目的地终于出现在视野中了。

examples.en: The aircraft was able to fly over the endless white plains without difficulty.
examples.zh: 飞机能够毫无困难地飞越无边无际的白色平原。

examples.en: She finished the test without difficulty.
examples.zh: 她毫不费力地完成了考试。

examples.en: They took photographs of the mountains that lay below.
examples.zh: 他们拍摄了位于下方的山脉照片。

examples.en: A beautiful valley lay below the mountain.
examples.zh: 山下是一片美丽的山谷。

examples.en: Byrd at once ordered his men to throw out two heavy food sacks.
examples.zh: 伯德立刻命令他的手下扔出两个沉重的食物袋。

examples.en: When he heard the news, he left at once.
examples.zh: 他一听到消息就立刻离开了。

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词 + (by + 过去时间/when/before...)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作，由had + 过去分词构成 用于描述两个过去的动作，先发生的动作用过去完成时，后发生的动作用一般过去时。常与before, after, when, by等连用。

examples.en: In 1929, three years after his flight over the North Pole, the American explorer successfully flew over the South Pole.
examples.zh: 1929年，在他飞越北极三年后，这位美国探险家成功飞越了南极。

examples.en: By the time we arrived, the train had left.
examples.zh: 当我们到达时，火车已经开走了。

grammar.title: be able to 的用法
grammar.structure: 主语 + be (was/were) able to + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 表示"能够；会"，强调通过努力成功做到某事 be able to 表示成功完成某事的能力，强调克服困难后成功。与can相比，be able to 更强调成功的意味，可用于各种时态。

examples.en: Byrd and his men were able to take a great many photographs.
examples.zh: 伯德和他的手下能够拍摄大量照片。

examples.en: The plane was then able to rise and it cleared the mountains by 400 feet.
examples.zh: 飞机随后能够上升，以400英尺的高度越过了山脉。

examples.en: Byrd now knew that he would be able to reach the South Pole.
examples.zh: 伯德现在知道他能够到达南极。

grammar.title: if 引导的真实条件句
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + 动词现在式..., 主语 + will/can + 动词原形...
grammar.definition: 表示真实可能发生的情况，if从句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时 用于讨论真实、可能发生的条件。当条件满足时，结果就会发生。if表示"如果；要是"。

examples.en: It could only get over the mountains if it rose to 10,000 feet.
examples.zh: 只有上升到一万英尺才能越过这些山脉。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我就待在家里。

original.en: Byrd and his men were able to take a great many photographs of the mountains that lay below.
original.zh: 伯德和他的手下能够拍摄位于下方的山脉的大量照片。

imitations.en: The rescue team was able to reach the survivors in time.
imitations.zh: 救援队能够及时到达幸存者那里。

imitations.en: She was able to solve the difficult problem alone.
imitations.zh: 她能够独自解决这个难题。

original.en: At one point, it seemed certain that their plane would crash.
original.zh: 在某个时刻，看起来他们的飞机肯定会坠毁。

imitations.en: It seemed certain that they would win the championship.
imitations.zh: 看起来他们肯定会赢得冠军。

imitations.en: It seemed certain that the storm would destroy the town.
imitations.zh: 看起来风暴肯定会摧毁这个城镇。

original.en: It could only get over the mountains if it rose to 10,000 feet.
original.zh: 只有上升到一万英尺才能越过这些山脉。

imitations.en: You can only succeed if you work hard.
imitations.zh: 只有努力工作才能成功。

imitations.en: The patient can only recover if he follows the doctor's advice.
imitations.zh: 只有遵从医嘱，病人才能康复。

original.en: For there were no more mountains in sight.
original.zh: 因为眼前再也没有山脉了。

imitations.en: There were no more obstacles in sight.
There were no more difficulties in sight.

lines.en: In 1929, three years after his flight over the North Pole, the American explorer , R.E.
lines.zh: 美国探险家R.E.伯德在飞越北极3年之后，于1929年第一次飞越了南极。

lines.en: Byrd, successfully flew over the South Pole for the first time. Though, at first, Byrd and his men were able to take a great many photographs of the mountains that lay below, they soon ran into serious trouble.
lines.zh: 虽然开始时伯德和他的助手们拍下了飞机下面连绵群山的大量照片，但他们很快就陷入了困境。

lines.en: At one point, it seemed certain that their plane would crash.
lines.zh: 在有个地方，飞机似乎肯定要坠毁了。

lines.en: It could only get over the mountains if it rose to 10,000 feet.
lines.zh: 只有在飞至10,000英尺的高度时，它才能飞过这些山头。

lines.en: Byrd at once ordered his men to throw out two heavy food sacks . The plane was then able to rise and it cleared the mountains by 400 feet.
lines.zh: 伯德马上命令他的助手们把两个沉重的食物袋扔掉，于是飞机可以上升了，它在离山头400英尺的高度飞越了过去。

lines.en: Byrd now knew that he would be able to reach the South Pole which was 300 miles away, for there were no more mountains in sight.
lines.zh: 伯德这时知道他能够顺利飞抵300英里以外的南极了，因为前面再没有山了。

lines.en: The aircraft was able to fly over the endless white plains without difficulty
lines.zh: 飞机可以毫无困难地飞过这片茫茫无际的白色原野！

questions.q: How was the plane able to clear the mountains?
questions.zh: 飞机是怎样才得以飞越那些山头的？
questions.a: Byrd at once ordered his men to throw out two heavy food sacks. The plane was then able to rise and it cleared the mountains by 400 feet.
questions.aZh: 伯德立刻命令助手们扔掉两个沉重的食物袋，飞机因此得以升高，并以 400 英尺的余量飞越了山头。

questions.q: What were Byrd and his men able to do at first, and what happened soon after?
questions.zh: 起初伯德一行能做什么？不久后又发生了什么？
questions.a: At first they were able to take a great many photographs of the mountains that lay below, but they soon ran into serious trouble.
questions.aZh: 起初他们拍下了飞机下方群山的大量照片，但很快就陷入了严重的困境。

questions.q: How high did the plane have to rise before it could get over the mountains?
questions.zh: 飞机必须升到多高才能越过群山？
questions.a: It could only get over the mountains if it rose to 10,000 feet.
questions.aZh: 它只有升到 10,000 英尺的高度，才能越过这些山头。

questions.q: Why was Byrd certain that he would be able to reach the South Pole?
questions.zh: 伯德为什么确信自己能飞抵南极？
questions.a: Because there were no more mountains in sight and the aircraft could fly over the endless white plains without difficulty.
questions.aZh: 因为眼前再没有山了，飞机可以毫无困难地飞过这片茫茫无际的白色原野。

questions.q: What do you think of Byrd's decision to throw out the food sacks?
questions.zh: 你如何看待伯德扔掉食物袋的决定？
questions.a: It was a quick and sensible decision: throwing out the two heavy food sacks was the only way to make the plane lighter and rise above the mountains, so losing some food was far better than crashing.
questions.aZh: 这是一个果断而明智的决定：扔掉食物袋是让飞机减重上升的唯一办法，损失一些食物远好过坠毁。
questions.hint: 结合 run into serious trouble 与 rise to 10,000 feet。

translation:
美国探险家R.E.伯德在飞越北极3年之后，于1929年第一次飞越了南极。
虽然开始时伯德和他的助手们拍下了飞机下面连绵群山的大量照片，但他们很快就陷入了困境。
在有个地方，飞机似乎肯定要坠毁了。
只有在飞至10,000英尺的高度时，它才能飞过这些山头。
伯德马上命令他的助手们把两个沉重的食物袋扔掉，于是飞机可以上升了，它在离山头400英尺的高度飞越了过去。
伯德这时知道他能够顺利飞抵300英里以外的南极了，因为前面再没有山了。
飞机可以毫无困难地飞过这片茫茫无际的白色原野！
title: Over the South Pole
subtitle: 飞越南极

lead.question: 伯德飞越南极时飞机险些坠毁，他们用什么办法越过了群山？
lead.warmup: 1929年，美国探险家 R.E. 伯德在飞越北极三年之后，第一次飞越了南极。机上的人先为脚下连绵的群山拍下大量照片，转眼却陷入险境：飞机只有升到 10,000 英尺才能越过山头。伯德当机立断，命令助手扔掉两个沉重的食物袋，飞机随即上升，并以 400 英尺的余量飞越群山。
goals: 辨析 can/could 与 be able to 在“具体某次成功做成”上的差别
运用 for the first time、at first、at once、run into、get over、in sight 等短语
区分 at/over/above 等方位介词及 by 表示“相差”的用法
lead.summary: 课文按“顺利拍照—突遇险情—减重爬升—化险为夷”推进：先交代伯德 1929 年首次飞越南极，再用 though 引出转折，最后以扔掉食物袋、飞机上升并以 400 英尺余量越过山头收束。语言上要抓牢 be able to 表“成功做成”，以及 clear（不接触地越过）、by（相差）、in sight（看得见）。
lead.tips: be able to 强调“过去某次成功做成”，失败或否定才用 couldn't；本课 were able to take、was able to rise 不宜换成 could。

exercises.q: 填词（flight / explorer / pole / lie）：Three years after his ____ over the North ____, the American ____, R.E. Byrd, flew over the South ____ for the first time; the mountains that ____ below were in his photographs.
用 can/could 或 be able to 的正确形式填空：They tried several times and at last they ____ take a great many photographs.
exercises.note: 过去某次成功做成用 were able to。

exercises.q: 用 run into 的适当形式填空：Soon after taking the photographs, they ____ serious trouble.
exercises.note: run into trouble 陷入困境。

exercises.q: 选词填空（get over / clear）：The plane could only ____ the mountains if it rose to 10,000 feet, and at last it ____ them by 400 feet.
介词填空（at / over / above / on）：The plane flew ____ the mountains and stayed ____ 10,000 feet.
exercises.note: over 从上方越过；at 接具体高度。

exercises.q: 汉译英：伯德马上命令他的助手们把两个沉重的食物袋扔掉。
exercises.a: Byrd at once ordered his men to throw out two heavy food sacks.

exercises.q: 用 at first 或 for the first time 填空：____ they were able to take photographs; in 1929 Byrd flew over the South Pole ____.
exercises.a: At first; for the first time

quiz.q: 课文中 it cleared the mountains by 400 feet 的意思是什么？
options: The plane flew over the mountains with 400 feet to spare.
The plane hit the mountains 400 feet below the top.
The plane flew at 400 feet above sea level.
The plane stopped 400 feet away from the mountains.
quiz.note: clear 不接触地越过；by 表示相差。

quiz.q: At one point, it seemed certain that their plane would crash. 句中的 at one point 在本课应理解为？
options: At a certain place on the way
At a certain moment in the past
On one particular opinion
At least in one respect
quiz.note: 此处指飞行途中的某处。

quiz.q: there were no more mountains in sight 中 in sight 的含义是？
options: within the range of vision
out of the range of vision
below the line of vision
as expected by everyone
quiz.note: in sight 在看得见的范围内。

quiz.q: their plane would crash 中的 crash 指什么？
options: hit the ground and be destroyed
land safely on the snow
rise higher into the sky
run out of fuel slowly

quiz.q: they were able to take a great many photographs 一句强调什么？
options: They succeeded in taking the photographs.
They had a general ability to take photographs.
They were allowed to take photographs.
They were forced to take photographs.
quiz.note: be able to 强调具体某一次成功做到。

quiz.q: they soon ran into serious trouble 中的 ran into 可以替换为？
options: got into
got over
ran out of
ran away from
quiz.note: run into trouble 等于 get into trouble。
